fields.facilityId: Warehouse or terminal id where the truck waited
fields.carrierName: Trucking company that hauled the load
fields.arrivalClass: EARLY, ON_TIME, LATE relative to appointment + grace
fields.action: Settlement outcome on PayPal: VOID, CAPTURE, CAPTURE_AND_INVOICE, HOLD_FOR_REVIEW
fields.dwellMin: Minutes on site counted by the detention clock
fields.billableMin: Minutes billed after free time and carrier-caused delay
fields.chargeUsd: Total owed by the shipper (detention + shipper line items), USD
fields.capturedUsd: Captured from the PayPal authorization hold, USD
fields.releasedUsd: Uncaptured hold released back to the shipper, USD
fields.invoicedUsd: Billed by PayPal invoice above the capture ceiling, USD
fields.carrierPayoutUsd: Paid to the carrier via PayPal Payouts, USD
fields.carrierOwesUsd: Carrier liabilities exceeding its earnings, invoiced to the carrier, USD
fields.lineItemCount: Number of damage, seal, cold-chain or hardware line items
fields.needsReview: True when evidence was insufficient and money did not move automatically
fields.claimedUsd: Amount the carrier claims on paper; for review rows this is revenue at risk, USD
fields.auditTrail: Step-by-step deterministic explanation of the settlement
fields.paypalAuthorizationId: PayPal authorization id of the hold
